VAULTS.Sync.MissingPackages: This vault expects compendium package(s) this world can't read: {packages}. Those pages will sync as journals but instantiate no document.
VAULTS.Sync.PagesFailed: {count} page(s) failed to sync and will be retried on the next sync. See the console for details.
VAULTS.Sync.MissingDocuments: {count} page(s) have no document in this world. An incremental sync won't notice them again — use Force Sync to restore.
VAULTS.Sync.VersionSkew: {count} document(s) came from a different Foundry generation and may not render correctly. See the console for which pack, and which version it targets.
VAULTS.Sync.InstancesSkipped: {count} page(s) declared foundry.base but no document was created. See the console for details.
VAULTS.Sync.NothingToDo: Vault is already up to date.
VAULTS.Sync.TokenExpired: Vault token for {name} has expired. Click Authenticate, then Sync again.
VAULTS.Importer.Missing: This vault ships no importer ({url}/_foundry/importer.js 404'd). Either it has opted out of Foundry integration with foundry_package: none, or its CLI predates the importer and needs a re-deploy.
VAULTS.Importer.FetchFailed: Could not fetch the vault importer: {message}
VAULTS.Importer.EvalFailed: Failed to evaluate the vault importer: {message}
VAULTS.Importer.ModuleTooOld: {name} ships an importer that needs a newer Wizzlethorpe Vaults module than this world has. Update the module and try again.
VAULTS.Importer.TrustPrompt:
This is the first sync from {url}. The wiki ships its own importer code, which will run inside Foundry.

Bundle fingerprint: {hash}

Continue only if you trust the vault author.
VAULTS.Importer.HashChanged:
The importer at {url} has changed since you last trusted it.

Old: {oldHash}
New: {newHash}

Accept the new bundle and continue?
VAULTS.Connect.StepOpen: Open the vault sign-in page in your browser:
VAULTS.Connect.StepPaste: Paste the token shown back here:
VAULTS.Connect.PasteInvalid: That doesn't look like a token. Tokens have three dot-separated parts.
VAULTS.Connect.PasteExpired: That token has already expired. Open the sign-in page again to get a fresh one.
VAULTS.Dialog.Title: Vaults
VAULTS.Dialog.RemoveHint: Remove deletes this vault's journals and image cache from the world. The vault on the server is not affected.
VAULTS.Dialog.RemoveConfirmBody: Delete all journals and cached images for {name}? This can't be undone (you can re-sync to restore).
VAULTS.Dialog.StatusUnreachable: Vault unreachable: {reason}. Sync and Authenticate are disabled until it responds.
VAULTS.Dialog.AuthFailedNotice: Token rejected by the vault (it may have been rotated). You'll need to sign in again.
VAULTS.Dialog.NoFoundryPackage: {name} has opted out of Foundry integration (foundry_package: none), so there is nothing to sync. Its author would need to change that setting and re-deploy.
VAULTS.HandlerAssets.SessionPromptTitle: Run handler scripts from this vault?
VAULTS.HandlerAssets.SessionPromptIntro: Vault "{name}" is about to run {size} KB of JavaScript inside this Foundry session ({reason}).
VAULTS.HandlerAssets.SessionPromptWarn: This script will run with full access to game state, hooks, and document data. It can read player input, modify actors, or call external services.
VAULTS.HandlerAssets.SessionPromptDeclin: If you decline, nothing from this vault runs and the rest of the sync is unaffected. You'll be asked again next time it syncs.
